asset_classes.verbatim_source: U.S. Treasury Bills, Bonds, and Notes... Maximum Maturity: 15 Years; Maximum Net Worth Limit: None; Maximum Portfolio Limit: 100%
Agency Bullet Securities: Maximum Maturity: 15 Years; Maximum Net Worth Limit: None; Maximum Portfolio Limit: 100%

Agency Callable, Step-Up, and Floating-Rate Securities... Maximum Maturity: 10 Years; Maximum Portfolio Limit: 50%; Minimum Call Protection: 1 Year. Structured notes designed in an over-the-counter manner specifically for an institution... are not a permissible investment.
Agency MBS Passthrough: Maximum Net Worth Limit: None; Maximum Portfolio Limit: 100%

Structures allowed are as follows: sequential pay CMOs and planned amortization class (PAC) CMOs. Structures prohibited are: support tranche CMOs and stripped mortgage-backed securities. Maximum Portfolio Limit: 100%
Agency CMBS... Structures include passthrough and real estate mortgage investment conduit (REMIC) securities... Maximum Portfolio Limit: 100%

U.S. Agency Securities backed by Home Equity Conversion Mortgages... Maximum Portfolio Limit: 50%; Single Security Limit: 10% of Net Worth; Single Issuer Limit: 100% of Net Worth; Maximum Maturity: 50 Years; Maximum Weighted Average Life: 20 Years
SBA Fixed and Floating-Rate: Maximum Net Worth Limit: None; Maximum Portfolio Limit: 25%
Investment Repurchase and Borrowing Repurchase Agreements (REPO)... Maximum Maturity: 2 years; Maximum Portfolio Limit: 100%

Municipal Debt Securities... only 'investment grade' rated bonds may be purchased. Maximum Maturity: 15 Years; Single Issuer Limit: 25% of Net Worth; Maximum Net Worth Limit: 50%, combined with all other Muni Investments
Non-agency MBS... Single Security Limit: 10% of Net Worth; Maximum Net Worth Limit: 75%; Maximum Portfolio Limit: 25%; Minimum Rating: AA (minus)
Corporate Bonds... Maximum Maturity: 10 Years; Single Issuer Net Worth Limit: 10%; Maximum Net Worth Limit: 50%; Maximum Portfolio Limit: 25%. Only 'investment grade' rated bonds may be purchased.

asset_classes.subcategory: NCUA/FDIC Insured Bank, Thrift, and CU Instruments
asset_classes.verbatim_source: Instruments Issued by NCUA or FDIC Insured Banks, Thrifts, and Credit Unions. Investments $250,000 or less... Maximum Maturity: 5 Years; Single Security Limit: $250,000; Maximum Net Worth Limit: None; Maximum Portfolio Limit: None

Mutual funds provided the prospectus of the fund explicitly states the fund can only engage in investment and investment-related activities permissible under Regulation 703 and the Federal Credit Union Act.

portfolio_level_limits.concentration_notes: Given a parallel yield curve shift of 300 basis points, the aggregate price depreciation of the investment portfolio should not exceed 15% of the portfolio. The effective duration of the portfolio in the base scenario should not exceed 4%.

prohibited_practices: Over-the-counter custom structured notes lacking liquidity
Non-agency MBS backed by commercial loans (other than multifamily)
unmapped_clauses: At least monthly, a Federal credit union must prepare a written report setting forth, for each security held, the fair value and dollar change since the prior month-end, with summary information for the entire portfolio.

At least quarterly... written report setting forth the sum of the fair values of all fixed and variable rate securities held that have... Embedded options; Remaining maturities greater than 3 years; or Coupon formulas that are related to more than one index or are inversely related to, or multiples of, an index.

Where the amount calculated... is greater than a Federal credit union's net worth, the report... must provide a reasonable and supportable estimate of the potential impact... of an immediate and sustained parallel shift in market interest rates of plus and minus 300 basis points.
